using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpResults;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace eShop.Ordering.API.Apis;

public class OrdersApiTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<OrdersApi>> _loggerMock;
    private readonly Mock<IMediator> _mediatorMock;
    private readonly Mock<IIdentityService> _identityServiceMock;
    private readonly Mock<IOrderQueries> _queriesMock;
    private readonly OrderServices _services;

    public OrdersApiTests()
    {
        _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<OrdersApi>>();
        _mediatorMock = new Mock<IMediator>();
        _identityServiceMock = new Mock<IIdentityService>();
        _queriesMock = new Mock<IOrderQueries>();
        _services = new OrderServices(_loggerMock.Object, _mediatorMock.Object, _identityServiceMock.Object, _queriesMock.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateOrderAsync_WhenRequestIdIsEmpty_LogsWarningAndReturnsBadRequest()
    {
        // Arrange
        var emptyRequestId = Guid.Empty;
        var request = new CreateOrderRequest(
            UserId: "user1",
            UserName: "Test User",
            City: "Test City",
            Street: "123 Test St",
            State: "TS",
            Country: "USA",
            ZipCode: "12345",
            CardNumber: "1234567890123456",
            CardHolderName: "Test Holder",
            CardExpiration: DateTime.Now.AddYears(1),
            CardSecurityNumber: "123",
            CardTypeId: 1,
            Buyer: "buyer1",
            Items: new List<BasketItem>());

        // Act
        var result = await OrdersApi.CreateOrderAsync(emptyRequestId, request, _services);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    fs => fs.ToString().Contains("Invalid IntegrationEvent - RequestId is missing")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);

        var badRequestResult = Assert.IsType<BadRequest<string>>(result);
        Assert.Equal("RequestId is missing.", badRequestResult.Value);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateOrderAsync_WhenMediatorReturnsFalse_LogsWarningWithRequestId()
    {
        // Arrange
        var requestId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var request = new CreateOrderRequest(
            UserId: "user1",
            UserName: "Test User",
            City: "Test City",
            Street: "123 Test St",
            State: "TS",
            Country: "USA",
            ZipCode: "12345",
            CardNumber: "1234567890123456", // 16 chars
            CardHolderName: "Test Holder",
            CardExpiration: DateTime.Now.AddYears(1),
            CardSecurityNumber: "123",
            CardTypeId: 1,
            Buyer: "buyer1",
            Items: new List<BasketItem>());

        // Setup mediator to return false (simulate failure)
        _mediatorMock
            .Setup(x => x.Send(It.IsAny<IdentifiedCommand<CreateOrderCommand, bool>>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(false);

        // Act
        var result = await OrdersApi.CreateOrderAsync(requestId, request, _services);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    fs => fs.ToString().Contains("CreateOrderCommand failed") && 
                          fs.ToString().Contains(requestId.ToString())),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);

        var okResult = Assert.IsType<Ok>(result);
    }
}

                It.IsAny<Exception>(),

            Times.Once);

        var badRequestResult = Assert.IsType<BadRequest<string>>(result);
        Assert.Equal("RequestId is missing.", badRequestResult.Value);
    }

    public async Task CreateOrderAsync_WhenCreateOrderFails_LogsWarningWithRequestId()
    {

        var requestId = Guid.NewGuid();

        var mockMediator = new Mock<IMediator>();
        mockMediator.Setup(x => x.Send(It.IsAny<IdentifiedCommand<CreateOrderCommand, bool>>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))

        var services = new OrderServices(mockLogger.Object, mockMediator.Object, Mock.Of<IIdentityService>(), Mock.Of<IOrderQueries>());

        // Act
        var result = await OrdersApi.CreateOrderAsync(requestId, request, services);

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("CreateOrderCommand failed") && 
                                              v.ToString().Contains(requestId.ToString())),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);

        Assert.IsType<Ok>(result);
    }

    private static CreateOrderRequest CreateValidRequest()
    {
        return new CreateOrderRequest(
            UserId: "user1",
            UserName: "Test User",
            City: "Test City",
            Street: "123 Test St",
            State: "TS",
            Country: "USA",

            Items: new List<BasketItem>());
    }
